scope: Eight original unpublished scheduled lectures after interpolation and lines/bounds. Full Korean source scripts read; these are insertion plans, not completed videos or approval.
preservation: Keep all original scenes, bilingual wording, claims, worked examples, formulas and their order. Separate new speech/visuals; never overwrite baseline audio or uploaded originals.
